firstPlayerRule: A player brave enough to take the opening turn goes first; play then continues clockwise.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: The rule does not ask the group to rank everyone's bravery or specify a contest.
